object_description: well-proportioned two-story volume enclosing differentiated outdoor spaces
design_condition: The compact two-story building follows the local grain and surrounding clinic orientation, closes the site toward the residential area, and organizes entrances and outdoor spaces around its eastern traffic routes and southern courtyard.

positive.statement: The well-proportioned volume fits very well into the existing local grain.
The surrounding open spaces are redefined clearly, with a pleasant green space in front of the building and a courtyard formed by the existing buildings.
The entrances are easy to find and readily accessible for operational processes.
The building expression provides appropriate livability without the harshness of a prison.
The clearly structured floor plan implements complex usage processes and security requirements optimally.
Naturally lit corridors and vertically connected outdoor spaces create spaciousness and differentiated movement areas.
The project fully meets requirements for operation and security through a carefully developed spatial structure.

negative.statement: The entrances are somewhat removed from public view, despite remaining easy to find and accessible.
The playing field is rather tight and its limited clear height may require an exchange of uses between floors.
The building volume and construction costs are on the higher side in comparison.
Areas, volumes and building standards need revision to optimize costs.
The span of the ground-floor walking yard needs to be revised.
The roof design and solar systems must account for supervision from neighbouring buildings.
The height of the vehicle-lock gate must be adjusted to the required clearance.
